Our client is a wholesale company based in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, specialized in the distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables in Belgium and the Netherlands.

For decades, this wholesale organization has been active in the fresh produce sector, using its knowledge and experience every day to search for opportunities, innovations, and top-quality products.

They can rightfully call themselves a leading player in the distribution, import, and export of fruit and vegetables.

Would you like to be part of their team?

Our client is looking for a motivated CE truck driver!

• Holder of a CE driving license with valid Code 95.
• Hard worker, committed to your job, with respect for customers, colleagues, and entrusted equipment.
• Not afraid of loading and unloading yourself.
• You will be the company’s calling card.
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your CV today, and we’ll get to work for you!

REF:MEC

• CE driving license.
• Code 95.
• Initial experience in distribution is an asset.
• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays.
• Flexible, customer-oriented, and punctual.
• Flexible availability for both day and night shifts (both are required).
• Good knowledge of Dutch or French and English (understanding, writing, and speaking).

Job Function
 

The hired individual will be attached to the International and Institutional Affairs Department – Mobility and Congress, primarily responsible for administrative management of the department.
 

Tasks
 

Administering the management of the department's email inquiries and secretarial tasks.
 

Processing various documents.
 

Providing administrative support to team members.
 

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation
 

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.
 

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints
 

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators
 

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Requirements:
 

Bachelor's degree in administration
 

Proficient written and spoken English (minimum B2 level)
 

Minimum 2 years of experience in administration
 

Excellent spelling and grammar
 

Ability to analyze and synthesize information
 

Organizational skills, attention to detail, dynamism, adaptability to priorities, and flexibility
 

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team
 

Proficiency in computer tools (MS Office)
 

Knowledge of the academic and research world

Our client is a company located in the heart of Belgium's textile industry, with a team of passionate and talented professionals committed to delivering quality, service, and innovation.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated: warehouse worker - order picker

You will join a modern carpet weaving company with a warehousing environment, where you will help ensure a smooth flow of goods.

Your Responsibilities

 
• 
Registering and storing finished carpets using a scanning system.

 
• 
Picking orders according to the instructions provided.

 
• 
Assisting with loading trucks and containers.

 
• 
Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised working environment.

 
• 
Actively contributing to efficient warehouse management.

 
• 
Working with an internal scanning and order-picking system (training provided).

We are looking for someone who:

 
• 
Communicates fluently in Dutch OR English.

 
• 
Holds a valid forklift operator certificate.

 
• 
Is motivated and eager to learn.

 
• 
Enjoys working in a team and takes responsibility.

 
• 
Pays attention to organisation, safety, and cleanliness.

 
• 
Is physically fit for manual work and is not afraid of heights.

 
• 
Has experience in warehousing and order picking (an advantage, but not a requirement).

Do you have a little experience in communications and you are looking for experience in an international environment? We're looking for you for a 5-month project (ASAP - Early October) !
 

Main mission 
 

The candidate will be responsible for assisting the Communication Officer in the creation and integration of content on their website.
 

 
 

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation
 

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.
 

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints
 

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators
 

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Profile 
 

Bilingual in French and English, both spoken and written
 

At least two years' experience in copywriting and content integration in drupal
 

Very good knowledge of the CMS
 

Good knowledge of digital marketing, copywriting and SEO
 

Personality: customer-oriented, creative, proactive, autonomous, good writing and communication skills, good organisational skills, team player

Mission
 

You will be responsible for the administrative organization of meetings, the HCP/HCO contracting process, the transparency reports for events with healthcare professionals in respect of budget, local rules, and internal compliance rules.
 

Customer Focus
 

Key Objectives/Deliverables:
 

HCP Meetings And Contracts Management
 

HealthCare Organisation Sponsorship Management
 

Compliance
 

Business Planning And Operations

Requirements  
 

Minimum education level: Bachelor’s degree.
 

Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly with all audiences and forums through exemplary English, Dutch and French oral and written communication skills.
 

Pharmaceutical industry experience, and/or customer service experience in meeting management.
 

Ability to travel up to 20% (between Belgium and the Netherlands);
 

Excellent time-management, and critical thinking skills with ability to work effectively in a team, cross-functional, matrix, and global multi-cultural and virtual environment.
 

Demonstrate strong customer focus with the ability to develop professional relationships in all aspects of the position that result in stable, consistent, reliable, and courteous communication when dealing with other key business partners and external customers.
 

Strong proficiency and learning agility with various computer applications and software.
 

Ability to solve problems and work independently in a changing and multi-tasking environment with numerous deadlines.  
 

Additional info:
 

Contract of limited duration of 1 year

Ensure the efficient daily operation of the Brussels office and support the team in achieving objectives.
 

Manage the team’s annual calendar, integrating all Group and Entity deadlines.
 

Organize internal and external meetings, seminars, and events, handling logistics, participant coordination, and agenda preparation.
 

Prepare accurate presentations, draft meeting minutes, and ensure follow-up on agreed actions.

As part of the ASP service within the IT department, client is looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure reliable, compliant, and optimized management of the IT software license portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring activities, with a strong focus on coordination between IT, Procurement, and Finance teams. The consultant will contribute to cost control, license compliance, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management processes.
Key responsibilities

• Manage the complete lifecycle of IT licenses: request, approval, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, and renewal

• Maintain an accurate, reliable, and up-to-date database of active, expired, renewable, and licenses to be retired

• Analyze contracts, terms of use, and license clauses in collaboration with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Analyze software usage data to identify unused, underused, or oversized licenses

• Propose optimization actions to reduce costs and improve license utilization

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators covering active licenses, unused licenses, upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and potential savings

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making

• Provide administrative and analytical follow-up for Software Asset Management activities

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of SAM processes and data quality

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has solid experience in Software Asset Management or IT Asset Management, combined with strong administrative, analytical, and license-management skills.

They are able to work independently, analyze complex data, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.

Mandatory skills

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a role related to:

• Software Asset Management

• IT License Management

• IT Asset Management

• IT Procurement

• or a similar function

• Good knowledge of software licensing models from major software vendors

• Experience analyzing and monitoring software contracts and licensing terms

• Strong ability to analyze software usage data

• Good knowledge of at least one analytical tool such as advanced Excel, SQL, or Power BI

• Ability to prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards

• French or Dutch with fluent English

• Strong administrative rigor and ability to manage multiple cases efficiently

• Autonomous, proactive, and ownership-driven mindset

 

Strong assets

• Experience with SAM/ITAM solutions

• Strong knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI

• Experience with software cost optimization and renewal management

• Experience working in a complex IT or large-enterprise environment

• Experience collaborating with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

Professional & soft skills

• Excellent analytical skills

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

• Autonomous and responsible

• Proactive with a strong sense of initiative

• Strong ownership and accountability

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills

• Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Results-oriented and focused on continuous improvement

• Critical thinking and solution-oriented approach

• Handle general accounting, invoice management, VAT, budget, forecasts, audits, and risk management 
 
• Work closely with other companies at an international level 
 
• Participate in hands-on accounting practices with internal training provided by team members 
 
• Ensure the management of financial processes within the company 
 
• Contribute to various accounting tasks related to agriculture and the agrifood sector 

 
 
• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field 
 
• Proficiency in English (minimum C1) and French (minimum B2) 
 
• Previous experience in an accounting environment is a plus, but not mandatory 
 
• Open-minded, with the ability to ask questions and express oneself confidently in English 
 
• Motivated, autonomous, and ready to thrive in a dynamic and international environment

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

jobs.description:
Are you accurate, motivated, and do you enjoy working in a logistics environment? GXO Logistics in Tongeren is looking for enthousiastic high working order pickers to strengthen the team as soon as possible.

At GXO, you will work in a modern and technology-driven environment where collaboration and continuous improvement are key.

Your responsibilities: 

 
• Collecting goods in the warehouse using a scanner or pick list 
 
• Picking products correctly according to orders and quantities 
 
• Retrieving items from racks or pallets 
 
• Preparing orders in bins or on pallets 
 
• Checking picked goods for accuracy 
 
• Working according to safety and quality regulations 

 
• Accurate with attention to detail 
 
• Able to work efficiently and meet deadlines 
 
• Physical work does not scare you (a lot of walking and lifting) 
 
• Good communication with colleagues and supervisors 
 
• Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required 
 
• Basic knowledge of scanners or voice picking is an advantage 
 
• Willing to work in a two-shift system (early/late) 
 
• Good command of English and/or Dutch 
 
• Valid certificate or experience high orderpick truck

For a client in Duffel we are looking for a temporary 
Customer Service Representative.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• You process customer orders accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner, while closely following up to ensure excellent customer service. 

• You respond to customer inquiries and emails and ensure smooth communication with clients. 

• You manage metal contracts and related administration. 

• You handle customer complaints in a professional and solution-oriented way. 

• You support the sales team with efficient administrative organization to guarantee continuity and high-quality customer support.  

 

Profile
 
 

• You hold at least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in a commercial or administrative field. 

• You have an excellent command of English and German. Additional languages are considered a plus. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office applications; knowledge of SAP is an advantage. 

• Experience in or affinity with an industrial environment is a strong asset. 

• You are stress-resistant and able to work efficiently under pressure. 

• You are customer-oriented, communicative, and a good listener. 

• You are proactive, persistent, and able to think creatively when solving problems.

Production | Quality Control | Team Leadership | Operations | Rework | 5S | 3-Shift System

As a Production & Quality Shift Leader, you coordinate the overall operational activities during your shift. You supervise Team Leaders, allocate available resources across different activities and monitor daily targets related to safety, quality, delivery and efficiency.

About the CompanyYou will join an international industrial environment where quality, safety and operational efficiency are key. As a Shift Leader, you take ownership of the daily activities during your shift and ensure that production and quality objectives are achieved.

Your New Role
 Your responsibilities include:
• Coordinating daily operational activities during the shift
• Supervising, supporting and coaching Team Leaders
• Allocating employees and resources according to operational priorities
• Monitoring productivity, rework levels and quality performance
• Ensuring compliance with work instructions, quality controls and procedures
• Conducting shift briefings and ensuring a clear handover between shifts
• Monitoring operational and quality reporting
• Coordinating inspection, sorting and rework activities
• Ensuring compliance with safety, 5S and quality standards
• Identifying and escalating operational, quality or personnel-related issues 
Your Profile
• Experience leading teams within a production, manufacturing or industrial environment
• Good understanding of quality processes, inspection and rework
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
• Able to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges
• Strong communication and leadership skills
• Hands-on mindset and comfortable working closely with the shop floor
• Strong focus on safety, quality and operational efficiency
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Willing to work in a 3-shift rotation
• Valid driver's license and access to a car

As Administrative Supervisor, you will take full ownership of the day-to-day administrative operations and process management of the Belgian office. You will act as the central link between management, employees, and external partners, ensuring the office runs efficiently, enabling the business team to focus on core objectives, and supporting the company's compliant operations and continued development in Belgium and across Europe.
 

 

Minimum 2 years of experience as an Administrative Supervisor, Office Manager, or equivalent role • Fluent in English and Dutch (written and spoken); Chinese language skills are a strong plus for communicating with headquarters and Asian teams • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common administrative management systems • Excellent organizational skills, multitasking ability, and priority management • Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of independently solving problems • Outstanding communication and coordination skills, able to collaborate effectively with colleagues and external partners at all levels and from diverse cultural backgrounds • Legal authorization to work in Belgium Preferred • Experience in international trade, wholesale, or technology industries • Familiarity with Belgian labor law and administrative compliance requirements • Basic communication skills in French • Experience in a startup or fast-growing company environment

At Allseas, we enable the development of groundbreaking offshore solutions that support the energy transition. Our success depends on making informed decisions, managing resources effectively, and continuously improving the way we operate.
 

Within Business Finance, we act as trusted partners to the business, enabling sustainable performance through cost transparency, financial planning, data-driven insights, and strong financial governance. We challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and support the business in turning strategy into results.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a 
Finance Business Partner for Crewing.
 

 
 

Your role
 

 
 

As Finance Business Partner for Crewing, you will support one of the most critical functions within Allseas: ensuring our vessels are staffed with the right people, at the right time, and at the right cost.
 

You will partner closely with Crewing, Vessel Management, Human Resources, and Operations leadership, providing financial insight and decision support that enables effective workforce planning, cost management, and operational performance.
 

You will act as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts, challenge assumptions, evaluate opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

Business Partnering & Decision Support
 
 

• Partner with Crewing and Vessel Management to support operational and strategic decision-making. 

• Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and actionable recommendations. 

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization. 

• Challenge assumptions and support management in making informed decisions.  

Financial Planning & Performance Management
 
 

• Lead budgeting and forecasting activities. 

• Monitor financial performance and analyse variances against budget and forecast. 

• Provide timely insights into cost drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.  

Cost Transparency & Reporting
 
 

• Deliver reliable and business-relevant financial reporting. 

• Develop and enhance management dashboards and performance analyses.  

Process Improvement & Financial Governance
 
 

• Safeguard data integrity and compliance with financial standards and policies. 

• Identify and implement improvements in end-to-end business processes, systems (SAP, PowerBI) 

You are curious, analytical, and eager to understand how the business operates. You enjoy working with stakeholders across different disciplines and can translate complex data into practical business insights.
 

You also have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and help drive positive change.
 

Qualifications:
 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• 5 years of experience in Business Finance, Financial Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. 

• Experience in a project-driven, engineering, offshore, maritime, or international environment is an advantage.  

Skills:
 
 

• Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to influence and challenge constructively. 

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and business case development. 

• Strong affinity with digital reporting solutions and data analytics. 

• Experience with SAP and Power BI is preferred. 

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
